The base query starts with three positive maximum-Float32 minima and three negative maximum-Float32 maxima. It filters collection entries through an object predicate, excludes one queried interface and unions valid object boxes.

The concrete model candidate has a special-source branch. A source flag together with a valid special box can return before the ordinary aggregate. Otherwise it obtains ordinary bounds and performs inclusive scalar merges.
Finite box validity requires ordered minima/maxima on all axes and strict limits inside the extreme Float32 sentinels.
The valid-source union uses source-operand scalar min/max instructions. Equal finite coordinate choices retain source order, including signed-zero choices.

The ordinary collector delegates to a distinct enumeration helper with further type, predicate and transform paths. The special-source bounds helper also has backend-specific records and child-bound paths.
